_comment: Shared fixture for the ONE agent-instruction-path definition (E80.12 / #3942): backend/internal/agentpaths (the canonical list, read by the review sandbox and the backend policy gate) and its twin runner/internal/constraint/agentpaths.go. Both modules' tests assert their Go lists equal config_dirs and instruction_files, and drive match (must be an instruction path) and no_match (must not) through the sandbox extractor and both constraint evaluators, so any divergence fails a test. Probes cover every dir and basename at the root, nested, and re-cased. Every path here is DATA ONLY: never create a file at one of them.
